articles.summary: BEDMINSTER, N.J., Sept. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Peapack-Gladstone Financial Corporation (NASDAQ Global Select Market: PGC) and Peapack Private announced today its entrance into the yacht financing business, further expanding the Bank’s suite of customized lending solutions for high-net-worth individuals, families and their advisors. As part of the launch, Peapack Private has hired industry veterans, Jim Velez, and Derick Buffum, to lead the new Yacht Financing team. Velez brings more than four decades of specialized yacht finance experience to Peapack Private, with a proven track record of building and leading successful yacht lending businesses. Buffum brings extensive expertise in yacht lending, credit, and underwriting, with significant experience structuring complex financing solutions for ultra-high-net-worth clients. articles.summary: BEDMINSTER, N.J., Sept. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - - Peapack-Gladstone Financial Corporation (NASDAQ Global Select Market: PGC) and Peapack Private Bank Trust are pleased to announce the opening of the Company’s newly completed Garden City office, marking another milestone in the Bank's strategic expansion throughout the New York metropolitan market. The new office reinforces Peapack Private's commitment to serving Long Island's successful individuals, families, business owners, professionals, and institutions with a highly personalized approach to private banking, lending, and wealth management. Having established a presence in Garden City, Peapack Private now welcomes clients to its permanent office, thoughtfully designed to reflect the sophisticated, relationship-focused experience that defines the Bank.
